raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`map_mxfp4_backend()` maps four `moe_backend` names to exactly one MXFP4 activation variant, but none of them is in the `MoEBackend` literal, so `--moe-backend` and `--kernel-config` reject them at argument parsing and those mapping entries are unreachable. For a model whose MXFP4 MoE selector ignores `quantization_config.moe.activation`, these names are the only way to request an activation-quantized variant: `aiter` and `flashinfer_*` walk their variants BF16-first. The env path from #58819 covers only the AITER fused-MoE path for the model types it names.

## Claims

- Add `aiter_mxfp4_fp8`, `aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4`, `flashinfer_trtllm_afp8` and `flashinfer_cutlass_afp8` to `MoEBackend` and document them in `KernelConfig.moe_backend`.
- Selection logic is unchanged; none of these backends is chosen unless requested by name.

| alias | backend |
|---|---|
| `aiter_mxfp4_fp8` | `AITER_MXFP4_FP8` (W4A8) |
| `aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4` | `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` (W4A4) |
| `flashinfer_trtllm_afp8` | `FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MXFP4_MXFP8` |
| `flashinfer_cutlass_afp8` | `FLASHINFER_CUTLASS_MXFP4_MXFP8` |

## Validation

8x MI355X, an MXFP4 MoE checkpoint served with `--moe-backend aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4`: the log reports `Using 'AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4' Mxfp4 MoE backend` instead of `AITER_MXFP4_BF16`; gsm8k 0.95 (default backend about 0.955). This PR only makes the backend selectable; any speed or accuracy difference belongs to the backend.

New `tests/config/test_moe_backend_aliases.py`: each alias parses from `--moe-backend <alias-with-dashes>` through `EngineArgs` and maps to exactly one backend.

<details>
<summary>commands and output</summary>

Rebased on main `db3b0f0fa`, CPU only:

```
$ pytest tests/config/test_moe_backend_aliases.py     # with this change
4 passed, 1 warning in 2.26s

# vllm/config/kernel.py reverted to main
__main__.py: error: argument --moe-backend: invalid choice: 'flashinfer_cutlass_afp8' (choose from 'aiter', 'aiter_mega_moe', ...)
FAILED tests/config/test_moe_backend_aliases.py::test_alias_parses_from_cli[aiter_mxfp4_fp8]
FAILED tests/config/test_moe_backend_aliases.py::test_alias_parses_from_cli[aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4]
FAILED tests/config/test_moe_backend_aliases.py::test_alias_parses_from_cli[flashinfer_trtllm_afp8]
FAILED tests/config/test_moe_backend_aliases.py::test_alias_parses_from_cli[flashinfer_cutlass_afp8]
4 failed, 1 warning in 2.80s
```

ruff, typos, SPDX and mypy (3.11 hook) are clean.
</details>

## Details

With `--kernel-config '{"moe_backend": "aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4"}'` the failure is a pydantic `literal_error` on `KernelConfig.moe_backend`; with `--moe-backend` it is the argparse `invalid choice` above.

AI assistance (Claude) was used to write this change, its tests and this description.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The single-variant MXFP4 MoE backend aliases are accepted on the CLI."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.engine.arg_utils import EngineArgs
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import (
+    Mxfp4MoeBackend,
+    map_mxfp4_backend,
+)
+from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
+
+ALIASES = {
+    "aiter_mxfp4_fp8": Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_FP8,
+    "aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4": Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4,
+    "flashinfer_trtllm_afp8": Mxfp4MoeBackend.FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MXFP4_MXFP8,
+    "flashinfer_cutlass_afp8": Mxfp4MoeBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTLASS_MXFP4_MXFP8,
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("alias", list(ALIASES))
+def test_alias_parses_from_cli(alias: str):
+    parser = EngineArgs.add_cli_args(FlexibleArgumentParser())
+    args = parser.parse_args(["--moe-backend", alias.replace("_", "-")])
+    assert EngineArgs.from_cli_args(args).moe_backend == alias
+    assert map_mxfp4_backend(alias) == [ALIASES[alias]]

@@ -127,7 +127,9 @@ def with_default(
     "deep_gemm_mega_moe",
     "cutlass",
     "flashinfer_trtllm",
+    "flashinfer_trtllm_afp8",
     "flashinfer_cutlass",
+    "flashinfer_cutlass_afp8",
     "flashinfer_cutedsl",
     "flashinfer_moe_ep_cutedsl",
     "flashinfer_b12x",
@@ -140,6 +142,8 @@ def with_default(
     "aiter_mega_moe",
     "aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16",
     "aiter_triton_mxfp4_mxfp4",
+    "aiter_mxfp4_fp8",
+    "aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4",
     "flydsl",
     "hpc",
     "emulation",
@@ -309,7 +313,11 @@ class KernelConfig:
     - "deep_gemm_mega_moe": Use DeepGEMM mega MoE kernels
     - "cutlass": Use vLLM CUTLASS kernels
     - "flashinfer_trtllm": Use FlashInfer with TRTLLM-GEN kernels
+    - "flashinfer_trtllm_afp8": Use FlashInfer TRTLLM-GEN MXFP4 MoE with MXFP8
+      activations only (MXFP4 checkpoints)
     - "flashinfer_cutlass": Use FlashInfer with CUTLASS kernels
+    - "flashinfer_cutlass_afp8": Use FlashInfer CUTLASS MXFP4 MoE with MXFP8
+      activations only (MXFP4 checkpoints)
     - "flashinfer_cutedsl": Use FlashInfer with CuteDSL kernels (FP4 only)
     - "flashinfer_moe_ep_cutedsl": Use FlashInfer's CuTeDSL MoE-EP
       mega-kernel with NVFP4 weights (MXFP4 checkpoints are requantized at
@@ -332,6 +340,11 @@ class KernelConfig:
       (moe_gemm_a16w4) MoE kernel (ROCm gfx942/gfx950/gfx1250)
     - "aiter_triton_mxfp4_mxfp4": Use the AITER Triton/Gluon MXFP4 W4A4
       (moe_gemm_a4w4) MoE kernel (ROCm gfx1250)
+    - "aiter_mxfp4_fp8": Use the AITER MXFP4 MoE kernel with FP8 activations
+      (W4A8, static per-tensor input scales; MXFP4 checkpoints, ROCm only)
+    - "aiter_mxfp4_mxfp4": Use the AITER MXFP4 MoE kernel with MXFP4
+      activations (W4A4; MXFP4 checkpoints, ROCm only). Unlike "aiter", which
+      tries the BF16-activation variant first, this selects W4A4 only
     - "flydsl": Use AMD FlyDSL kernels (ROCm only)
     - "rdna3": Use the fused RDNA3 W4A16 HIP kernel (ROCm gfx1100 only)
     - "hpc": Use HPC kernels (FP8 and Hopper only)
